title: StoryboardCardUpdateRequest
description: Payload for updating a storyboard card's speaker, voice persona, dialogue, or motion parameters.

speaker.description: Name or archetype of the character speaking.

voice_persona.description: Voice actor identifier or persona key (e.g. en-US-GuyNeural, cartoon_animal).

dialogue_text.description: Spoken dialogue line for this beat.

visual_prompt.description: Visual motion prompt for diffusion generation.
